proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11165 lohita explicitly gives regional lahū/lehū/lau, Jaunsari loī and Khowar lei in the addendum. These blood forms fit the documented red-to-blood family; very contracted Khowar le remains a comparison with a possible lohī alternative. The comparative family link retains uncertainty about transfer between Indo-Aryan languages.
